d.s: SikaTard-960 HC is an admixture designed to delay cement hydration. SikaTard-960 HC facilitates stabilization of concrete mixtures for long periods with no negative effects on final quality.
a: Does not contain materials promoting steel corrosion.
Complements most of the ViscoCrete superplasticizer for a cost-effective shotcrete base mix.
With the use of Sigunit accelerators cement hydration can be re-started on demand.
us: SikaTard-960 HC is recommended for the following applications:
where the temporary prevention of cement hydration of concrete is required
d.pk: Bulk deliveries 1000 litre IBC 10 litre container

sec.t: SikaTard-960 HC is a set retarding admixture meeting the requirements of AS1478.1 – 2000 Type Re.
A solution of specially selected surface active organic compounds.
Stored at temperatures between 5° C and 35° C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight and frost, shelf life is one (1) year.
Store protected from direct sunlight and frost at temperatures between 5° C and 35° C .
